description: This file defines the base class 'IpcModuleBase' for IPC module testing, including mock objects, setup methods, and related includes.

classes.name: IpcModuleBase
classes.description: A base class providing mock IPC components and setup methods for testing IPC modules.

methods.name: expectInitIpc
methods.description: Prepares expectations for successful IPC initialization.

methods.name: expectInitIpcFailure
methods.description: Prepares expectations for IPC initialization failure.

methods.name: expectInitIpcButAttachChannelFailure
methods.description: Prepares expectations for failure when attaching channel after IPC init.

methods.name: expectAttachChannel
methods.description: Sets expectations for attaching a channel.

methods.name: expectIpcApiCallDisconnected
methods.description: Sets expectations for an IPC API call resulting in disconnection.

methods.name: expectIpcApiCallReconnected
methods.description: Sets expectations for an IPC API call resulting in reconnection.

methods.name: expectIpcApiCallSuccess
methods.description: Sets expectations for a successful IPC API call.

methods.name: expectIpcApiCallFailure
methods.description: Sets expectations for a failed IPC API call.
